## AI Disk Keeper {{VERSION}}

{{SIGNING_STATUS}}

**Requires macOS {{MIN_MACOS}} or later** (Apple silicon and Intel).

### Install
1. Download `AI-Disk-Keeper-{{VERSION}}.dmg`, open it, drag **AI Disk Keeper** to Applications.
2. Optional: grant Full Disk Access (System Settings → Privacy & Security) to scan protected folders.

### Highlights
- _Edit before publishing._

### Safety
Scans are read-only. Cleanup moves items to the Trash by default and is logged to
`~/Library/Application Support/AIDiskKeeper/audit.jsonl`.
